faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Assistant posts at IIT Madras is 17 September 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Madras Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant post in the Indian Institute of Technology Madras Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Madras Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Assistant positions at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Assistant post at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position at IIT Madras will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Postgraduate degree in Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, along with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. A background in Linguistics is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIT Madras Research Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant post includes shortlisting of applications, followed by a Test/Interview, and finally Document Verification for selected candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT Madras Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Madras or by using the direct "Apply Online" link provided in the Important Links section of the article before 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Research Assistant position at IIT Madras is a contractual job type. It offers an opportunity to work in a government organization on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Assistant position is Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Selected candidates will be required to work at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras campus.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for IIT Madras careers?
faq.answer: The official website for careers at IIT Madras, where you can find more details and apply, is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/. Candidates should visit this site for authentic information.
